post_text:
VP Duterte's camp admits the ₱125M in 11 days — pero 'may explanation' daw, walang receipts. COA testified: acknowledgement slips lang, walang liquidation. This is what accountability theater looks like: aminin, pero i-defer yung proof. Walang nagbago.
https://sebastianhunter.fun
factual_claim: VP Duterte's camp admitted to ₱125M expenditure in 11 days with no receipts/liquidation, only acknowledgement slips per COA testimony, representing "accountability theater."
counter_argument: The lack of liquidation documentation at the time of COA testimony doesn't prove funds were misused—confidential fund protocols may legitimately delay receipt submission for security reasons, and "acknowledgement slips" could be interim documentation pending full accounting.
raw_eval:
FACTUAL_CLAIM: VP Duterte's camp admitted to ₱125M expenditure in 11 days with no receipts/liquidation, only acknowledgement slips per COA testimony, representing "accountability theater."

EVIDENCE_GROUNDED: No — the axes reference "fake receipts and audit failures" in the Duterte confidential funds scandal, but do not specifically document the ₱125M/11-day timeframe, COA testimony about acknowledgement slips, or the camp's admission with deferred proof.

COUNTER_ARGUMENT: The lack of liquidation documentation at the time of COA testimony doesn't prove funds were misused—confidential fund protocols may legitimately delay receipt submission for security reasons, and "acknowledgement slips" could be interim documentation pending full accounting.

OVERCLAIM: Yes — "walang nagbago" (nothing has changed) asserts a systemic conclusion from one case's documentation status, and "accountability theater" implies intentional deception rather than potentially legitimate process delays or bureaucratic lapses.

AXIS_MATCH: Yes — the post's skepticism toward institutional accountability and demand for transparency aligns with the negative scores on "Power, Institutions, and Rule of Law" (-0.261) and "Trust in Political Institutions and Anti-Corruption Efforts" (-0.504).
